name: Analytics
description: Advanced analytics integration with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and custom event tracking.

settings.label: GTM container ID
settings.description: Your Google Tag Manager container ID (e.g. GTM-XXXXXXX).

settings.label: Respect Do Not Track
settings.description: Honour browser Do Not Track settings (applies to all providers).

settings.label: Enable Consent Mode v2
settings.description: Google Consent Mode v2 — default deny state until the user grants consent via a banner or consent management platform.

settings.label: Enable Enhanced Ecommerce
settings.description: Track purchase, product view, add-to-cart and checkout events. Requires WooCommerce.

settings.label: Currency code
settings.description: Default currency code for ecommerce tracking (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

settings.label: Custom event tracking
settings.description: Which custom events to track. GA4 fires enhanced events; GTM pushes equivalent dataLayer events.

options.label: File downloads (PDF, DOC, ZIP, MP3, MP4, …)

settings.label: Exclude user roles
settings.description: Disable all tracking for users with these roles. Useful for excluding admins and editors.

settings.label: Track Core Web Vitals
settings.description: Send page performance metrics (LCP, CLS, INP) as GA4 events for SEO insights.

settings.label: Custom GA4 config parameters
settings.description: JSON object merged into the GA4 config call. Advanced. Use for custom dimensions, debug mode, etc.
